description: Daily point-in-time snapshot of the tradable asset list, taken before 08:30 America/New_York. Backtests build universes from the snapshot dated on or before the trading day, never from today's listings (survivorship; P0 audit A5.1).

columns.name: snapshot_date
columns.description: Trading date (America/New_York) the snapshot is for.

columns.name: asset_id
columns.description: Vendor's stable asset id (survives symbol changes).

columns.name: backfilled
columns.description: true when reconstructed after the fact (e.g. from today's list); such rows carry survivorship bias and must be flagged in reports.

columns.name: universe
columns.description: top500 (monthly) | market_set (fixed ETFs); the method is in method_version.

columns.name: rank
columns.description: 1..500 by 20-day median dollar volume; null for market_set.

columns.name: last_close
columns.description: Raw close of the last bar before snapshot_date.

columns.name: median_dollar_volume
columns.description: Median of vwap*volume over the last 20 sessions before snapshot_date.

columns.name: bars_in_window
columns.description: Daily bars present among those 20 sessions.

columns.name: name_missing
columns.description: The vendor asset record has no name, so the common-stock check used symbol and exchange only.

columns.name: feed
columns.description: Feed of the daily bars the membership was computed from (sip).
